Class HierarchyNode

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.codemodel.HierarchyNode
public class HierarchyNode extends Object
A recursive, token-efficient node representing a type hierarchy tree across any JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala) within the IntelliJ IDEA project model and index.

Eliminates redundant empty lists by using a single recursive children collection governed by the active HierarchyDirection (subtypes or supertypes), and avoids nested URL keychains by placing type identity, language, and origin location directly on each node.

Author:
anahata
